title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Shrek?
description:
Ten real pictures connect Adolf Hitler to Shrek, through Hindenburg, the Kaiser, Teddy Roosevelt, every president to Reagan, Arnold, Obama, King Charles, Mark Carney and Mike Myers.

Adolf Hitler → Paul von Hindenburg → Wilhelm II, German Emperor → Theodore Roosevelt → Ronald Reagan → Arnold Schwarzenegger → Barack Obama → Charles III → Mark Carney → Mike Myers → Shrek

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Hindenburg: In 1933, Hitler shook hands with President Hindenburg, the old war hero who had just made him chancellor.
   Photo, CC BY-SA 3.0 de: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bundesarchiv_Bild_183-S38324,_Tag_von_Potsdam,_Adolf_Hitler,_Paul_v._Hindenburg.jpg
2. Hindenburg → Kaiser Wilhelm II: In 1917, Hindenburg studied war maps with his boss, Kaiser Wilhelm II, the last emperor of Germany.
   Photo by Robert Sennecke, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hindenburg,_Kaiser,_Ludendorff_HD-SN-99-02150.JPG
3. Kaiser Wilhelm II → Teddy Roosevelt: In 1910, the Kaiser took Teddy Roosevelt on horseback to watch the German army practice.
   Photo by Underwood & Underwood, photographer, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Theodore_Roosevelt_riding_on_horseback_with_Kaiser_Wilhelm_II_LCCN2013650883.jpg
4. Teddy Roosevelt → Ronald Reagan (15 portraits, every holder): Teddy Roosevelt was the 26th president, and the line runs all the way to the 40th, Ronald Reagan.
   Photo, Public domain / CC BY 2.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Theodore_Roosevelt_by_the_Pach_Bros.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Cabinet_card_of_William_Howard_Taft_by_Pach_Brothers_-_Cropped_to_image.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Woodrow_Wilson_Harris_%26_Ewing_(3x4_cropped_b).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Warren_G_Harding_portrait_as_senator_June_1920.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Calvin_Coolidge,_1924_portrait_photograph_(3x4_cropped).jpeg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Hoover_portrait.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:FDR_1944_Color_Portrait.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:TRUMAN_58-766-06_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Dwight_D._Eisenhower,_official_photo_portrait,_May_29,_1959.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:John_F._Kennedy,_White_House_color_photo_portrait.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Lyndon_B._Johnson,_photo_portrait,_leaning_on_chair,_color_cropped.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Richard_Nixon_presidential_portrait.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Gerald_Ford_presidential_portrait_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:JimmyCarterPortrait2.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ronald_Reagan_1981_presidential_portrait.jpg
5. Ronald Reagan → Arnold Schwarzenegger: In 1984, Reagan met a bodybuilder turned movie star, Arnold, at the Republican convention in Dallas.
   Photo by Richie Bendall, CC0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Ronald_Reagan_with_Arnold_Schwarzenegger_Retouched.jpg
6. Arnold Schwarzenegger → Barack Obama: In 2009, Arnold walked with Obama in Los Angeles.
   Photo by The White House from Washington, DC, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:P031909PS-0263_(3484026683).jpg
7. Barack Obama → King Charles: In 2011, Obama hosted Prince Charles in the Oval Office.
   Photo by The White House from Washington, DC, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:President_Barack_Obama_meets_with_Prince_Charles,_Prince_of_Wales,_in_the_Oval_Office,_May_4,_2011.jpg
8. King Charles → Mark Carney: In 2025, the King met Canada's Mark Carney.
   Photo by Hayden Soloviev, CC BY 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Diana_Carney,_King_Charles_III,_and_Mark_Carney_at_Rideau_Hall,_2025_(cropped).jpg
9. Mark Carney → Mike Myers: Who made an ad with Mike Myers.
   Photo by Liberal Party of Canada campaign ad (via CTV News), Fair use (commentary): https://www.ctvnews.ca/federal-election-2025/article/mike-myers-joins-mark-carney-in-liberal-ad-supporting-elbows-up-movement/
10. Mike Myers → Shrek: Who voices Shrek.
   Photo by DoD News, DreamWorks Pictures (via IMP Awards), CC BY 2.0 / Fair use (commentary): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Mike_Myers_2017_(37220071326)_(cropped).jpg + http://www.impawards.com/2001/shrek_ver3.html

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #shrek #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
